title: The ash is going
summary: Sixty-one trees counted along one lane. Nine still holding a full crown. Recorded now because it will not be possible later.

body.text: It is a strange thing to make a record whose only certain use is to show, later, what was there.

Counted on foot along 2.1 km of lane, both sides, every ash of trunk diameter greater than about 150 mm. Sixty-one trees. Nine with a crown the archive would describe as full. Twenty-two with visible dieback in the upper third. Thirty with substantial crown loss or already standing dead.

A small number of trees appear to be resisting. Whether this is tolerance or luck cannot be determined from a lane in Devon on a Tuesday, and the archive has recorded their positions in case it matters.
To be repeated annually while there is anything to repeat it on.

remark: Open survey. Second count due July 2027.
